tool.name: nf-core hifiasm
tool.description: Whole-genome assembly using PacBio HiFi reads
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ hifiasm \\ $args \\ -t ${task.cpus} \\ ${input_trio} \\ ${input_hic} \\ ${ultralong} \\ -o ${prefix} \\ ${long_reads_sorted} \\ 2>| >( tee ${prefix}.stderr.log >&2 )
if [ -f ${prefix}.ec.fa ]; then gzip ${prefix}.ec.fa fi
if [ -f ${prefix}.ovlp.paf ]; then gzip ${prefix}.ovlp.paf fi
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": hifiasm: \$(hifiasm --version 2>&1) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Whole-genome assembly using PacBio HiFi reads
